title: Split the cli spec: move the timing and reporting requirements REQ-cli-020, REQ-cli-024 and REQ-cli-028 to a new reporting module as REQ-reporting-001 to REQ-reporting-003 with wording unchanged and a documented ID mapping, so the cli requirements companion stays under the 65536-byte record bound
description: Split the cli spec: move the timing and reporting requirements REQ-cli-020, REQ-cli-024 and REQ-cli-028 to a new reporting module as REQ-reporting-001 to REQ-reporting-003 with wording unchanged and a documented ID mapping, so the cli requirements companion stays under the 65536-byte record bound
acceptance_criteria: specs/reporting is a new module that owns src/timing.rs and tests/timing.rs and holds REQ-reporting-001 to REQ-reporting-003, each with the exact wording of REQ-cli-020, REQ-cli-024 and REQ-cli-028 (their Trace lines unchanged, still naming LIFE-10); the old IDs are removed from specs/cli and become tombstones

tests/spec_split.rs proves the move lost nothing: every moved requirement body has the SHA-256 it had at main a33c747, every REQ-cli ID from 001 to 034 and 036 is either still in specs/cli or mapped, and a one-time before/after comparison of every cli requirement block is recorded

The ID mapping is documented in docs/FRD.md and the reporting module context; the cases that link only moved requirements move to .chough/cases/reporting.cases.toml under a documented case ID mapping with their bindings unchanged, and each case that also links a requirement staying in cli keeps its cli ID and those links and gains a TC-reporting twin with the identical binding for the moved requirement, so every requirement keeps every case binding it had
specs/cli/requirements.md is at most 59000 bytes, the record limit stays 65536 and no requirement, case binding or test is weakened
fmt, lint, the full tests, every moved and twinned case and fledge lanes run verify pass

answers.constraints: AGENTS.md: preserve existing files and records; never invent results. SpecSync requires REQ-<module>-<number> IDs per delta module and keeps removed IDs as permanent tombstones, so moved requirements get new reporting IDs with a documented mapping. A case links only requirements in its own module's companion, so a case that also links a requirement staying in cli keeps its cli ID and gains a TC-reporting twin with the identical binding. Archived changes, evidence and bug records stay untouched. Precedent: the 2026-11-03 history split (#59). Leif's standing Chough authority (2026-11-03 7:49 AM MST) forbids weakening assertions or gates; the record limit stays 65536
